definitions.explanation: The beverage made from roasted coffee beans. Very popular in Japan both hot and iced.

notes:
コーヒー is a loanword from Dutch/English "coffee."

COMMON TYPES:
- ブラックコーヒー: black coffee
- アイスコーヒー: iced coffee
- カフェオレ: café au lait
- インスタントコーヒー: instant coffee
- {缶|かん}コーヒー: canned coffee

ORDERING:
- コーヒーをください: Coffee, please
- ホットで/アイスで: Hot/Iced
- ブラックで: Black (no milk/sugar)

JAPANESE COFFEE CULTURE:
- {喫茶店|きっさてん}: traditional coffee shop
- カフェ: modern café
- {自販機|じはんき}の{缶|かん}コーヒー: canned coffee from vending machines (very popular)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- コーヒーを{入|い}れる: to brew coffee
- コーヒーを{飲|の}みに{行|い}く: to go for coffee
